title: Corte ukan arknaqatapa
intro: Poder pasillonakanx mä jach’a uñt’at jaqix mä uywataruw munasïna, jupax yaqha pachankir suma uñnaqt’anïnwa. Ukham munasiñax walja jan walinakaruw puriyäna, ukax chiqa chuymanïñ yant’añataki, imantat chiqa yatichäwinak uñacht’ayañataki, ukat qhiparux uka uywatax jan juchanïtap uñacht’ayañataki.
clues: Nayajj Nilo jawir oraqenwa jakayäta, uka palaciojj wali chʼamaniwa.
Mä waynaw utajarux mantanitayna, ukankatapax akapach jan walt’ayawayitu.
Nayax jupar sallqjañ yant'awayta, ukampis jupax Tatituparuw imantasïna.
Isipajj qhepäjjatwa chʼiyjawayta, ukampis kuna pruebanakatï sallqjatätaj uñachtʼayitu.
Noble warminakan chiqañchäwip amukt’ayañatakix mä tantachäwir jawst’ayäta ukat amparanakaparuw ch’ullqhi yänak uchawayta.
Tukuyañatakejja, jaqenak nayraqatanwa juchaj arsuyäta, rey nayraqatan cheqätap uñtʼayasa.

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
